printed_assignment_summary.semantics: These are category circles/references in the printed controller matrices, not a physical controller I/O-card, terminal, or device-count takeoff.

expanded_count_warning: Ninety-eight raw-text-cell-bounded source-matrix rows are presented under their printed system scopes. An additional 19-row M-803 boiler matrix is transcribed from matching MuPDF and Poppler visual renders because its outline text is not exposed by either raw-text engine. M-803 through M-805 say not all virtual points are shown; no unprinted device ownership, controller terminal/card capacity, field wiring count, or quantity multiplier is emitted.
ownership_binding_semantics: Matrix tag identities restart in each system table. The table/system scope is authoritative; similarly named tags in different matrices are not merged into a global device identity unless the drawings explicitly connect them.
